en: A sepia-toned aerial or elevated view of a rural village surrounded by fields and gardens. In the foreground there are farmhouses with tiled roofs and cultivated plots. Further back, more houses and farm buildings are visible among trees. A church with a tall spire rises on the left side of the horizon. The printed caption at the top left of the image reads "LENT in Vogelvlucht," suggesting a bird's‑eye view of the town of Lent.
